annotations.title: Take a spot on the AdSpace board (buy yourself onto the tool list)

description: LEGACY — the AdSpace spots board (planet/moon) is RETIRED as a public surface; joining the Rokha Network is free (page_claim) and rank is earned on the board (board_get). This door still answers for holders already on the old board. Requires Authorization: Bearer <JWT> from a Solana-wallet login.

amount_usd.description: whole USDC, at or above the price to take a spot

banner_url.description: https wide banner for your ad page (~1500×500; optional)

bio_md.description: long-form bio for your ad page — markdown, pretty-printed, up to 8,000 chars (optional)

slug.description: your /word (optional; made from the title if empty)

url.description: https link to what you're promoting

when.description: when Rokha should recommend you — e.g. 'someone asks about on-chain analytics' (what the agent matches against; be concrete)
